You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.  Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! No Accidents!  One Owner!               Convenience Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road. description: This 2022 Hyundai Tucson Limited combines practicality with refined comfort, offering you a well-equipped compact SUV ready for your daily demands and weekend adventures.  - Power moonroof with automatic operation - Navigation system with GPS - Apple CarPlay & Android Auto integration - Bose Premium audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio - Heated and ventilated front bucket seats - Memory power driver seat with power passenger seat - Power liftgate for easy cargo access - 19-inch machine-face alloy wheels - Heated steering wheel - Roof rack cross rails - Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone capability - Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off function - Emergency communication system with Blue Link Connected Car Service  The 2.5L four-cylinder engine delivers reliable performance with 187 horsepower, achieving an EPA-estimated 26 city and 33 highway miles per gallon. The eight-speed automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC manual control puts you in command of your driving experience while maximizing efficiency on every trip.  Built with your comfort in mind, this Tucson features heated front and rear seats along with ventilated front seating to meet every season's demands. The leather seat trim elevates the cabin environment, while the power-adjustable driver seat with memory function ensures you'll find your perfect driving position every time. Climate zones keep both front passengers comfortable independently, and the heated steering wheel adds another layer of refinement during cold weather.  Safety and convenience features work together to protect you and your family. The vehicle includes dual front and side-impact airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension for confident handling. The Blue Link Connected Car Service provides three years of complimentary emergency communication and remote vehicle capabilities right from your smartphone.  This Silver Tucson Limited comes equipped with practical features that enhance daily usabilityincluding a power liftgate that opens at the push of a button, roof rack cross rails for your gear, a cargo net to keep items secure, and a first aid kit for peace of mind. The HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenience, while the comprehensive Bose audio system with eight speakers ensures quality sound for your drive.  The cabin environment reflects attention to detail with automatic climate control, rain-sensing wipers, heated mirrors with power adjustment, and an illuminated entry system.
